title: Unhurried Is Now in the WordPress Theme Directory
excerpt: Our free block theme passed the WordPress.org review. You can now install Unhurried by searching for it inside WordPress.

body.text: Unhurried, the free block theme we [released in September](/projects/unhurried), has been approved for the official WordPress.org theme directory.
That means you no longer need to download a zip. In WordPress, go to Appearance, Themes, Add New, search for Unhurried, and click Install. Updates will arrive the same way as for any other theme.

Every theme in the directory goes through a review by volunteers on the WordPress Themes Team, who check the code, licensing and accessibility against [published requirements](https://make.wordpress.org/themes/handbook/review/required/). Thank you to them for the careful read.

If you run a shop, Unhurried Pro adds styled WooCommerce pages and a Coming soon page on top of the free theme. If you would rather have the site built for you, that is our [web development service](/services/web-development-mobile-apps).
